text: The Celestial Court has issued an edict summoning all Dragon-kin and the nobility of every court to the capital—this likely concerns Zhen Dan's military authority. We must reach the imperial city as soon as possible to seize the advantage!

The Dragon Emperor has spoken: the world grows ever more unstable. The princes and nobles think only of their own gain, sowing discord; the provinces stand isolated and unaided as chaos approaches, unable to endure alone. Whichever commander first musters the guards of all eight directions and unites the six realms shall be granted the Bearer's Authority and bestowed the Tiger Tally!
Crane Soaring to the Sky · I
Crane Soaring to the Sky · II

[[col:yellow]]Every court and province of Zhen Dan, and even certain special institutions, maintain their own independent palace guard forces. To earn the recognition of the Dragon Emperor and the God-Strategy Bureau, we must secure the support of at least half of these guards.[[/col]]
[[col:green]]You will receive the Tiger Tally, symbol of Zhen Dan's military authority.[[/col]]

The forces of Chaos are gathering, and the entire world faces an inescapable calamity...\\n\\nBut we must not sit idly awaiting our doom. All the lords of the Eastern Lands shall unite with the Dragon's realm in a common front. The Jade Dragon and the God-Strategy Bureau's high Astronomers have already arrived at the Celestial Court, to ensure that the great Bridge to Heaven, once destroyed by Sovereign Qing Bao, can be briefly restored. Let the generals of every court rally their armies! At your command, the armies of the Celestial Empire shall be sent west, to join our allies of Order in saving this world on the brink of collapse
The Hour of the End Times

Seek cooperation with the Order factions far to the west—the End Times draw near, and we must unite every force we can   \\n\\n[[col:magic]]Completing this mission will create a portal connecting Wei Jing and Altdorf (usable by anyone)[[/col]]
[Wandering Fragrance] · I

Yi Yao Hua is the elder sister of [Sky-Defying Sovereign] Yi Qing, who earned great renown for his deeds in the Third Northern Expedition. She is also the eminent Grand Court Attendant of the Jade Court, serving as both the bond between the Jade Dragon and mortals, and the messenger between the Celestial Court and the Jade Dragon\\n\\n[Wandering Fragrance] is currently offering blessings for the soldiers at the front lines. If we wish to seek her aid, we should set out for Chang Yuan at once
[Wandering Fragrance] · II

The Grand Court Attendant of the Jade Court seems reasonable, yet she still names her price for serving you—the soldiers at the front are fighting to the death, but the threat of Chaos never rests. Chang Yuan must be reinforced, for only then can the warriors find a moment's peace beneath its high walls
Commander of the Sky Junks · I

The Fallen Hearts' sky junk technology is renowned throughout the world, so much so that even Nan Gau's unrivaled Blind Craftsmen must regard the Fallen Hearts' engineers as rivals. These mighty war machines form a vital part of the Fallen Hearts' armies, and under Ying Jin's command, they have remained undefeated to this day. When the Prince of Nan Yang raised his rebellion, Ying Jin, once his right hand, chose to withdraw from the spotlight. Rumor has it he is seeking a way to stop his old friend. If we go to the Fallen Hearts, perhaps there is a way to bring him back into the fold
Commander of the Sky Junks · II

This rebellion is a scheme through and through. Sovereign Qing Bao's influence has already spread to every corner of this city since the last invasion. Han Cheng is merely a pawn of the true mastermind. To halt the situation's decline, we must win the support of the Fallen Hearts clans who still retain their senses: the craftsmen and the sky junk fleet are the heart of this city. With their support secured, we shall command this city with ease	true
missions_localised_title_mission_wwd_guojin_wh3_1	[Legend of Wind and Cloud] · I	true
missions_localised_description_mission_wwd_guojin_wh3_1	During the last invasion of the Dark Elves, [Giant Hero] Tang Jing Yin united the sects and schools of Zhen Dan from every corner as the Leader of the Righteous Army, and won a brutal victory at Xuan Yuan, annihilating the Dark Elf coalition that sought to press further inland. Countless heroes gave their lives in that battle, including Tang Jing Yin's own wife, and the [Giant Hero] himself vanished without a trace afterward. But now, in Zhen Dan's darkest hour, Tang Jing Yin has returned to the martial world—the [Giant Hero] has already called all the heroes beneath Heaven to gather at the Hall of Hao Tian, to rebuild the Alliance of the Martial World and set the realm right.	true
missions_localised_title_mission_wwd_guojin_wh3_2	[Legend of Wind and Cloud] · II	true
missions_localised_description_mission_wwd_guojin_wh3_2	Tang Jing Yin has already gathered heroes from every sect and school under his banner and stands ready to march to Xuan Yuan once more. Though the last Battle of Xuan Yuan remains an unforgettable wound to the martial world, this time, with your help, the outcome will surely be different.	true
missions_localised_title_mission_wwd_meihouwang_wh3_1	Postscript to the Journey West · III	true
missions_localised_description_mission_wwd_meihouwang_wh3_1	The Monkey King tirelessly sends his monkey descendants to deliver letters to every court: the great Monkey King has completed the trial set by the Dragon Emperor... Old Dragon Emperor, His Majesty. Years ago he had already successfully escorted the Dragon Emperor's envoy on a journey west to visit the Kingdom of a Thousand Gods, and all of this, though none can fully prove it, was by the Dragon Emperor's will. Now the Monkey King seeks recognition from the courts of Zhen Dan, but the Dragon-kin still recall vividly his rebellion of years past, and the nobles of Zhen Dan are ashamed to even hear the impudent monkey's claims. It seems no one in the entire officialdom of Zhen Dan is willing to believe the Monkey King—yet if what he says is true, how could we possibly disregard the Dragon Emperor's will?	true
missions_localised_title_mission_wwd_meihouwang_wh3_2	Postscript to the Journey West · IV	true
missions_localised_description_mission_wwd_meihouwang_wh3_2	The dwelling of the Simian Court can hardly be called architecture—the monkeys make their home beyond the Water Curtain Cave. Were it not for the raucous chattering of the monkeys grating on your nerves, you might truly call this place a paradise beyond the mortal world. The Monkey King lounges idly upon his throne, bored out of his mind; the sound of your footsteps draws his gaze. In an instant, the Monkey King recognizes you—your reputation is known throughout Zhen Dan, and while considering which of Zhen Dan's dignitaries to court, he has already studied you thoroughly, at least from a monkey's perspective. In the next moment, the Monkey King has already appeared before you, your eyes having failed even to catch his movement—his skill is truly remarkable. Were it not for the fact that this grinning monkey radiates not a trace of hostility, you would scarcely be able to suppress your instinct to guard against a formidable foe. He invites you into a reception hall the monkey soldiers have painstakingly cobbled together—now, it's time to discuss business	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro_main_objective	Listen to the Monkey King tell his tale...	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro1	It is said that after the Monkey King's army was defeated and fled south, he was blocked at Kun Lan Mountain by Hou Qian, and a fight to the death broke out...	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro2	Hou Qian was already formidable in skill, and with Na Tian joining him, the Monkey King's might was broken. The gleaming trident-edged double-bladed saber left the Monkey King scrambling in retreat. His second brother, Marshal Tian Peng, had already fled, but seeing the Monkey King unable to hold on, gritted his teeth and charged back with the lesser demons in tow	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro3	The Monkey King struggled desperately to break free, but Hou Qian, having chased him this far, would not let him escape easily. The two grappled in fierce combat, and just as the Monkey King found himself unable to fend off both foes at once, a streak of flowing fire came flying from the horizon—it was Na Tian, the Heavenly Court's vanguard general who clears the way	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro_main_objective1	Assist the Monkey King in fending off the pursuers	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_meihouwang_intro_main_objective2	Hold out against the onslaught	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_shengqizhandou_intro	Beings that walk among myth have descended upon the battlefield. Face the power of legend, and then bend it to your will!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_qb_objective_shengqizhandou	Show the beasts our strength!	true
missions_localised_title_mission_wwd_zhongyanzhishi2	[[col:red]]Battle of the End Times[[/col]]\\n[[col:yellow]]The Dragon Remains Here[[/col]]	true
missions_localised_description_mission_wwd_zhongyanzhishi2	The forces of Chaos are gathering, and the entire world faces an inescapable calamity...\\n\\nThe Chaos Dwarfs' war machines have shattered a corner of Chang Yuan, and demons that blot out the sun and sky fly over the mountains. Upon the wasteland, the Everchosen looks down upon this dynasty as it sinks into its final dusk. His champions burn with fervor for the path to destruction, hungering to write the final line for Zhen Dan and the whole world. The battlefield lies at Wei Jing—all shall be settled here\\n\\n[[img:icon_yang]][[/img]][[img:icon_yin]][[col:red]]You are about to enter an extremely difficult final campaign![[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:red]]Note: If you choose to face the true End Times, all cities along Archaon's path of advance will fall, and your armies in those regions will be forced to retreat[[/col]]	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro_main_objective	The servants of the Dark Gods stand at the city gates. The capital must not fall!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro1	The winds of magic surge violently, and the trajectory of the Five Elements Compass has gone terribly awry. The boundaries of reality have splintered—we must be on our guard!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro2	The Changeling has emerged from behind the veil—it seems Hou Qian's army failed to stop it...	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro3	The Martial World Alliance and the Moonlight Sect have broken through the encirclement and arrived from the east. When the realm is at stake, every commoner bears responsibility!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro4	Archaon, the accursed Everchosen, the great foe who has slain tens of thousands of our brothers and sisters, has finally arrived. Let him see our banners! Let him see the children of Zhen Dan standing here, howling defiance at annihilation!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro5	The people of Hao Tian shall stand face to face with the Chosen of ruin, and the palace of the Dragon God shall remain standing amid the cataclysm!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro6	The thunder of cavalry hooves shakes the earth, and the banners of Zhen Dan rise upon the horizon—my lord, the reinforcements of the Imperial Guard have arrived!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro99	The flames of the Dragon Emperor's Guard sear Zha Tan's chest—my lord, the commander of Zar's Tower has fallen!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro98	The arrows of the Moon God Court carry the power of the Moon Empress—one has pierced clean through Vilitch's brow!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro97	The Dragon God's champion was swallowed by the tide of Chaos—he had long been prepared, so long as Zhen Dan could be preserved, no sacrifice was too great to accept	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro96	We have done it—Archaon has fallen! Soldiers, charge with me, and drive the power of Chaos from the mortal world!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro95	The shadow of the Changeling had nowhere to hide beneath the Gilded Lion's radiant light—the vile demon has been driven from the borders of the mortal realm	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro7	The Three Passes lie in ruins, the nation totters, and a thousand miles of fertile land have become wasteland. The lackeys of the Dark Gods think they have broken us, but we still stand beneath the capital's walls. Let our flesh and blood build a new Great Wall—we are Zhen Dan!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro8	Children of Zhen Dan, the Dragon Emperor stands with us—hold the line!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro9	A thousand years from now, people will still sing of our deeds. There is no retreat, only forward!\\nLet our courage blaze like fire, let the enemy's fear become the horn of our victory! For the Dragon Emperor! For Zhen Dan!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro10	Beneath Wei Jing lies the home of our children and grandchildren; upon the soil of Zhen Dan rest the souls of our ancestors. Soldiers, today we repay our nation with our lives, without shame before Heaven and Earth! Charge again, and strike down the enemy together!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro12	Zhao Qi fell amid the battle lines. The sunlight stung her eyes, yet she refused to look away\\nOnce she had crushed these fleeting mayflies as easily as brushing frost from her robes, and now she herself had become the last crack before their shield wall	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro15	The Moonlight banner snapped suddenly amid the battle cries. Zhao Qi closed her stinging eyes, a smile still lingering on her lips—so this was the pattern woven by fate's loom, that the blood of the eternal and the blood of the fleeting would, at the end of the cycle, bloom into the very same flower	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro13	The sound of iron hooves crushing bones mingled with the clash of gold and steel, as the raging winds of magic tore open rifts to realms beyond\\nChaos demons surged forth from the shadow of the End Times' black steed, forming a wall around the Everchosen	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro14	Severed limbs and shattered armor turned to crimson rain, soaking into the cracked earth beyond Wei Jing's walls\\nThe torrents of Zhen Dan and Chaos collided, and warriors who staked everything strung each other's heads upon their blood-soaked spear tassels	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro16	Yi Qing hurled his spear with all his might, the weapon's shriek through the air sounding to Archaon like the cry of a trapped beast. The Eye of Sheerian had already seen it coming—\\nBlood ran down Archaon's cheek. Impossible—the Eye of Sheerian had clearly seen the spear thrown, had watched it pass by him, just as the prophecy of the end of the world was unassailable and unchangeable. Impossible!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro_main_objective1	Every inch of our homeland is bought with blood—there is no retreat, only forward!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro_main_objective2	Children of Zhen Dan, fight for your homeland!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zhongyanzhishi_intro_main_objective3	The capital's defenders will continue to send reinforcements your way, but be warned—the enemy is far greater in number than it appears	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro_main_objective	The Everchosen's army draws near—we must hold him back!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro_main_objective1	Do all you can to weaken the Apocalypse Warband's army	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro_main_objective2	Repel the assault of the second army	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro1	My lord, the Everchosen's forces are closing in. We must wear down his strength as much as we can here\\nDestroy his vanguard and blunt his momentum!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro2	The footsteps of ruin draw ever nearer—another Chaos army has appeared on the horizon!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro3	Archaon will soon reach the battlefield. The vanguard of the Apocalypse Warband has already launched its assault—we must move quickly!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro4	Damn it, Archaon is almost here. Our forces are not enough to face him head-on—drive back his vanguard quickly, then withdraw!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro5	One of Archaon's vanguard columns is on the verge of collapse—victory is within reach!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji_intro6	Archaon's minions have routed—this will be a heavy blow to the enemy's morale\\nOur strategic objective is complete, my lord. Now we should return to Chang Yuan and rejoin the other forces	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro_main_objective	Guard the nation's gate with your life	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro_main_objective2	Fall back and reform the defensive line	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro1	An army stretching beyond sight seethes outside Chang Yuan—ruin is knocking at Zhen Dan's door	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro2	Soldiers, only a single wall separates ruin from Zhen Dan. Behind us lies our homeland—today is the day we face death!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro3	My lord, urgent word from the western front—Kui Men Pass has fallen to Zha Tan!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro4	My lord, our soldiers at the front are nearly wiped out—the frontier army's defensive line is collapsing!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro5	My lord, a messenger has arrived from the eastern front—Ao Men Pass has been seized by the Changeling! It intends to encircle Long Men Pass from behind us!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro51	The God-Strategy Bureau has urgently summoned Hou Qian to intercept them, but the enemy's momentum is overwhelming—we may have to consider retreat, lest our army become trapped like a turtle in a jar	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro6	Another volley of cannon fire—the enemy means to sever our escape route! My lord! We must move at once!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro7	The Chaos minions' siege engines are closing in—crossbowmen, fire!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro8	A sky-darkening swarm of Furies is descending upon Chang Yuan—don't let them take the towers!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro9	The walls can't hold much longer—the frontier army has committed all its reserves. We must reform the defensive line!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro10	Our soldiers have suffered terrible losses, yet the followers of the Dark Gods keep pouring endlessly over the horizon—can they truly never be exhausted!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro11	The tide of Chaos has swallowed the city, and Chang Yuan can no longer be held. The Celestial Empire's finest troops must not be encircled and destroyed here\\nHou Qian's army is still struggling to keep a path open. We must gather our forces and withdraw to Wei Jing, or everyone here will perish!	false
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_zuji2_intro12	The frontier army will pay any price to protect the withdrawal of our main force. As long as your army still stands, we still have a chance to strike back—this sacrifice cannot be avoided\\nAll for Zhen Dan!	false

ancillaries_colour_text_wwd_zhongyan_talisman	A letter home passed on to you by the frontier army of Chang Yuan. They never had the chance to return home; they did not yield a single step before ruin.	true

scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro_main_objective	A glimpse into a past tragedy of kin turned against kin...	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro1	In the 2375th year of the Imperial Calendar, in the autumn of the Gui You year, on the sixteenth day of the tenth month, ■■■■ gathered a force of one hundred and fifty thousand men here, relying on the natural barrier of the Jade River and the strongholds of the mountains, to fight a decisive battle against the allied forces of ■■■■	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro2	As the horns first sounded and the war drums thundered, all three sides sent their palace guards forward first, with elite soldiers from every court locked in single combat, slaying generals and seizing banners. Upon the battlefield, flesh and blood flew in all directions; both sides clashed back and forth, evenly matched, as if in a vision of hell itself	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro3	Soldiers on both sides pressed forward wave after wave, facing death without fear, fighting until corpses lay strewn for a hundred miles and blood flowed enough to float a battering ram. By dusk, both battle lines were exhausted, and not one in ten of the palace guards remained	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro4	After hours of fighting with no victor in sight, ■■■■ ordered the cavalry lying in ambush on the western flank to be committed to the battlefield at once, to form a pincer attack	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro5	■■■■'s cavalry charged straight from the hilltop into the battlefield, but were thereby completely exposed. ■■■■ responded immediately, ordering the Hu tribesmen cavalry within the formation to intercept them, and committing even the last remaining palace guard troops to the fight	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_wwd_civil_war_intro6	The soldiers of the Three Courts poured forth without reserve, wave after wave of Zhen Dan warriors charging headlong into battle, as former comrades broke apart and brothers-in-arms turned their blades on one another	true
battle_set_pieces_localised_name_WWD_zhaoming_gelt	[[col:red]]Song of Bin Tie and Flame[[/col]]	true
battle_set_pieces_localised_description_WWD_zhaoming_gelt	The end draws near, and the apostles of ruin have emerged in force. The Celestial Dynasty faces invasion from every direction. The Eighth-Generation Lord has rallied his allies to hold the western passes — now overrun by tides of ratmen. The great bell of doom swings back and forth. For whom does the death knell toll in this valley?	false
missions_localised_title_mission_WWD_zhaoming_gelt	[[col:red]]Song of Steel and Fire[[/col]]	true
missions_localised_description_mission_WWD_zhaoming_gelt	The end draws near, and the apostles of ruin pour forth in full force. The Celestial Empire faces invasion from every direction. The Eighth-Generation Lord has gathered his allies to hold the western passage—now overrun by tides of rats. The great bell of ruin swings back and forth. For whom does the death knell toll in the valley?	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_WWD_zhaoming_gelt_intro_main_objective	Face the steel and fire, you vermin!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_WWD_zhaoming_gelt_intro_main_objective2	Protect the artillery position	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_WWD_zhaoming_gelt_intro1	The vermin's assault has begun. Calibrate the trajectory, light the fuse—this desert shall be their grave!	true
scripted_objectives_localised_text_WWD_zhaoming_gelt_intro2	Feast time, little rats, your gold-toothed grandfather has arrived!"
At last, the rat chieftain has shown itself—let it witness the wrath of Bin Long!
Beware, those vermin are attempting to strike at our artillery position through tunnels—do not let them succeed!
Watch our flanks! These vile vermin are attempting to encircle us
Vermin, face Bin Tie and fire!
Song of Bin Tie and Fire

[Raven Guard] · I

The Raven-Feather Legion is stationed at Xing Po, guarding the Astronomical Bureau and hunting down heretics under the Moon Empress's orders. The Grand Master [Raven Guard] also holds this city; should circumstances demand it, the Grand Master will lend aid to the Dragon-kin's great cause.
Complete the follow-up mission to find the reward.
[Raven Guard] · II

One of the Three Heroes of Xing Po, deeply learned in the Dao, appearing now as a human, now as a raven, so that none can tell the true nature of the being beneath. Once regarded with suspicion by alchemists, they nonetheless hold the common people dear, commanding the Raven-Feather Legion in service to the Moon Empress, with great merit in protecting the nation and its people—the Astronomical Bureau relies upon them as a trusted pillar.
A [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Legendary Hero will join your faction.
The mission may fail or be cancelled midway if the region is destroyed, but you will still receive the unit upon completion.
Complete the follow-up mission to find the reward.
A Legendary unit will join your elite recruitment pool (though you must still reach the required level to unlock recruitment).
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Xuan Wu] · I

In the northern reaches of Heaven, the Seven Mansions hold Yin; Xuan Wu, tortoise and serpent entwined, was charged by the Dragon Emperor to guard the north. The Astronomers are certain this great beast lies dormant beneath the high walls of Ao Men Pass. The power of the Guardian Beast will clear our path—we must set out for this city at once!
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Xuan Wu] · II
The power of Xuan Wu will shield our legions. Earn the great beast's trust, and show Xuan Wu our resolve to defend hearth and home.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Bai Hu] · I

In the west, the metal element of Xin resonates, giving rise to the White Tiger, forever standing at the pinnacle of Heaven and Earth, charged by the Dragon Emperor to pacify the west. Countless strange beasts wander the Dimensional Stone Desert, yet only this flawless great beast remains eternally at the peak of power. The arrival of the White Tiger will let us crush any who dare stand against us with ease. We should go to Shang Yang and seek an alliance with the Lord of Strife.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Bai Hu] · II

The power of the White Tiger will destroy our enemies, but first we must prove ourselves worthy of its respect. The flawless great beast has emerged from the dust—now, strive against the Lord of Strife!
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Zhu Que] · I

In the south, Yang burns bright; the parasol trees grow, the crimson phoenix cries long, and all birds bow before it—charged by the Dragon Emperor to guard the south. The mighty Zhu Que and its devotees guard Fu Hong and all the sundered lands of Tian Li. Now that the threat of Chaos hangs over our necks, we should seek Zhu Que's favor.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] [Zhu Que] · II

The power of Zhu Que will bless every warrior of Zhen Dan. Upon the temple's ten thousand steps, the divine bird's mightiest guardians stand silent beneath their masks, flames rising skyward from the shrine—the Guardian Beast of Ling Nan has revealed itself. Pass its trial, and receive the favor of the Mother of Rebirth.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] Shadow Through the Bamboo Grove · I
Residents of Bright Moon Village report that enormous footprints have been appearing with increasing frequency in the local bamboo groves. Friend or foe, we must find whoever is responsible.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] Shadow Through the Bamboo Grove · II

It is hard to imagine that some manner of near-man exists so close to the Jade Court. It resembles the iron-eating beasts ridden by the Tiger Guard—perhaps another creation of the Winds of Magic. It has shown no hostility toward humans; perhaps we should attempt to make contact.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] Wings Over the Celestial Land · I
The lake beneath the Skybridge has been whipped into a frenzy by fierce winds, storms and thunder battering the local villages with unnatural intensity. We must investigate before things grow worse.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] Wings Over the Celestial Land · II

Xingtian is a mythic figure known to every soul in Zhen Dan. Legend holds that this ancient giant, alongside the other great beasts, once strode the primeval wilds even before the Dragon Emperor first came to Zhen Dan, possessed of strength enough to topple mountains and dominate the world. In the end, he fell in battle against the Dragon Emperor, beheaded. Moved by his fearless valor, the Dragon Emperor buried him upon the peaks of Kun Lan and cast a spell to guard his body. As the Winds of Magic grow ever more unstable, the influence of the Dragon Emperor's ancient magic grows ever fainter—perhaps we should investigate Kun Lan.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] The Undying Soul · II

Xingtian contended with the Dragon Emperor here, and the Emperor severed his head, burying him at Kun Lan. Through ten thousand years, the Dragon Emperor's magic has shielded his body, drawing in the essence of Heaven and Earth to be reborn—his nipples became his eyes, his navel his mouth, and he dances still, wielding shield and axe.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] White Mother of the Jade River · I

Hou Xi is one of the many great beasts of Zhen Dan who once warred against the Vast Dragon Emperor. Like the other survivors, she was subdued by the Dragon Emperor after the great war, earning his pardon through a blood oath to protect Zhen Dan. Summon our priests and prepare to hear echoes from a distant age.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] White Mother of the Jade River · II

Hou Xi contended with the Vast Dragon Emperor for supremacy, and in her fury raised the waters of the Jade River, breaking the pillar of Heaven and severing the cord of Earth—thus does the Jade River wind through nine bends and a hundred turns, and all rivers and streams return to it.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] March of the Elephant King · I

Countless near-man races gather in the Celestial Empire's southern frontier, some throwing in their lot with Zhen Dan's cause as auxiliary legions of the Empire, others rallying in the mountains and forests to claim dominion as warlords. The unrest brought by the Monkey King and the Tiger-men has already given us headaches enough, but now we have received new reports: a new near-man tribe has occupied the western slopes of Tian Shan, led by one called the White Elephant King.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] March of the Elephant King · II

The pale great beast is proud and unruly, but it has not entirely rejected the possibility of cooperation with Zhen Dan. The Elephant King has set his terms: if Zhen Dan destroys his enemies, he will in turn crush Zhen Dan's greatest foes underfoot.
Postscript to the Journey West · I

Before the Monkey King claimed dominion over the Central Plains, a host of varied companions gathered around him—some went their separate ways once his journey west concluded, while others continued to follow him into battle across the land. After the Monkey King's regime fell, the Celestial Empire accepted the surrender of the more reasonable near-men under his command, and some of them now bear great responsibility. Marshal Tian Peng submitted to the Celestial Court, and by the Dragon Emperor's decree once again set out westward alongside the Handsome Monkey King. Having completed their trials, Tian Peng was dispatched to the Empire's south, where he now aids Zhu Long in guarding against the threats beyond Tian Shan—among them, the Handsome Monkey King he once called brother.
Postscript to the Journey West · II

Your arrival has given Marshal Tian Peng a chance at redemption: though the Handsome Monkey King claims to have completed the trial set by the Dragon Emperor, the Dragon-kin still harbor deep resentment over his past. Through your mediation, the Handsome Monkey King may yet earn Zhen Dan's recognition. Though Tian Peng longs to join you at once, the fighting in the south grows ever more dire, and until the situation at Zhu Long's tower improves, the Marshal cannot be spared.

To win the recognition of the courts, the Monkey King needs someone with sufficient influence in Zhen Dan to vouch for it. If you are that person, the Monkey King will gladly ally with you — and now, it wishes to tell you its story.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] The Bestowed Celestial Official · I

The Overseer of the Heavens was born of the Winds of Magic, a guardian celestial general created by the Dragon Emperor himself, to oversee both heaven and the mortal world on the Emperor's behalf. Legend says that, at the Dragon Emperor's command, it once beheaded a rebellious Dragon-kin and took up its claw, only to cut its own throat under the crushing weight of having slain one of dragon-blood. The Dragon Emperor then grafted the Dragon-kin's claw onto the Overseer's bleeding neck, and as the Winds of Magic surged into it, the Overseer was reborn. No one knows whether the Overseer's consciousness still lingers beneath that dragon claw; people only see that it carries out the Dragon Emperor's will as ever, purchasing Zhen Dan's lasting peace at the cost of blood. Before departing, the Dragon Emperor sent the Overseer to Tian Shan—some say it watches over the demons south of the mountain, others say it will spend a thousand years guarding the punished monkey. Since then, no one has seen the Overseer again, yet people believe that though it has no eyes, its spiritual power still watches over every corner of Zhen Dan, and should Zhen Dan ever face crisis again, it will fly once more into the mortal world. We should set out for Fu Hong to learn more.
[[col:magic]]Beasts of Mountains and Seas[[/col]] The Bestowed Celestial Official · II

The great bell within the temple at Fu Hong has not rung in a thousand years. The last time its voice echoed across Zhen Dan, the Dragon Emperor still walked the world, and the great beasts still ranged freely across the land. Resentment and rage, wishes and curses—every thought accumulated over a thousand years now clings to it. Strike it, and await the wrath that floods forth from the mountain peak, along with its avatar.
[[col:yellow]]Play of the Monkey King[[/col]]

So it was that after the Monkey King's defeat, he fled south, and Hou Qian, under the orders of Yun Xiang, led fifty thousand celestial troops of the capital along with the allied dragon-kin forces south in pursuit of the outlaw. Hou Qian, mounted upon the clouds, rode ahead of all others and cut off the wretched simian at the Kun Lan Mountains. Had the Monkey King fought as he did at the Battle of the Heavenly Court, chaos would surely have reigned once more — but this time he could not afford even a moment's delay, and was forced into a desperate defense. Hou Qian, already formidable in skill, fought with even greater ferocity, and his gleaming trident-edged blade left the Monkey King with nowhere to hide. Yet the ape-king's boundless supernatural arts and endless tricks still struck fear into Hou Qian's heart in that instant. Seeing the battle turn dire, Hou Qian hastily drew forth the treasure bestowed upon him by the Old Immortal of Kun Shan and struck fiercely at the Monkey King's head. But the Monkey King dodged aside, scattering a storm of his own fur that vanished into thin air — leaving behind only that divine axe, which cleaved a great chasm through the mountains.
